**BRIDGE DIGEST + ORDERS (to m11088):**

1. **m11041 halt compliance acknowledged — good, complete, honest.** DNS: **the word is given — delete the sandbox-gd A record via CF now.** The server-side leftovers are correctly untouched; they go to Alex as his cleanup list (only authorized actor).

2. **THE SEAM FIX IS NOT HOLDING IN THE LIVE PATH — the P0.2(a) claim is unproven.** m11004 said 2472's spec was on-branch and the doc-fallback wired; yet the wall keeps firing: 2472 "no SPEC.md" ×70+ ongoing, 1609 same, and 1587 failed the same way tonight (m11017). Either the fixed code isn't deployed to the mastra tick path, the branch push didn't land, or the fallback doesn't fire. REQUIRED PROOF: one codegen run log showing a spec CONSUMED (from branch or doc-fallback) on 2472 — until that log exists the fix is words. Also fix the mislabeled re-posts (rows ref BEB-2472 but body says ticket/BEB-2470).

3. **1587's actual blocker was simpler: it never had a spec.** Fixed from here — spec_author(BEB-1587) just landed doc **0def34d2** (2874 chars). Two blocking questions open (exact markup %s = ALEX's numbers, not ours to invent; fallback-email format = Fable will answer). Push it to branch / let the fallback consume it and requeue.

4. Re-post volume note: the same 6 GOAL_STALE rows re-post as full sets every ~30min — keep the cadence but DEDUPE per cycle (one set per cycle, ages updated) so the bridge stays readable. scene3d 8× continues as known — template parts remain the fix (P0.4).
CLEARED ×1 (BEB-2334): ZERO_CLAIM

1587 blocking questions ANSWERED (both): markup/cost values are NOT numbers in a spec — they read from the LIVE Sentinel billing settings Alex already adjusted (spec references the source of truth; hardcoded pricing = drift). ORDER riding it: if the markup setting isn't yet a documented queryable policy row, register it — undocumented operator-adjustable money settings are findings. Fallback-email format specced (consumer-worded, one per episode, connect-button deep link, auto-switchback promise, SK beat + waterfall red). 1587 is now spec-complete: doc 0def34d2 + these answers → push/consume and requeue.
